sentences.japanese: リンゴの花は霜でいたんでいた。
sentences.english: The apple-blossom was touched by the frost.

sentences.japanese: その霜でオレンジの収穫がだめになった。
sentences.english: The frost rendered the orange crop worthless.

sentences.japanese: その植物は霜で被害を受けた。
sentences.english: The plants were damaged by the frost.

sentences.japanese: 冬の朝には車の窓に霜が沢山つく。
sentences.english: Car windows accumulate frost on winter mornings.
